QuestInfo.name: [Home] The Vegetarian Werewolf
QuestInfo.1: Jeffrey the werewolf made a show of enjoying his salad, but Ethan still isn't convinced. Now Jeffrey is offering to prove that eating meat gives him hives. Isn't this going a little too far? Oh well! Go buy 10 #t2010001:#.
QuestInfo.2: The moment Jeffrey swallowed the #t2010001:#, his body turned red and became hovered with hives. It seems everything he said was true! Ethan felt so bad, he didn't know what to do.

default.0: Sorry to send you on another goose chase, but could you please bring me 10 #t2010001:#?
